items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1960-11-03
items.q: Dixieland musicians still playing in New Orleans are Alphonse Piku, 70, famous original Creole band clarinetist and Oscar Papacelostan, 64.

ctx.x: What was that Walking the Dog?

Remember that tune? I have the sheet music for that. I think I was by Shelton Brooks. Yeah, Walking the Dog, yeah. He's the one who wrote Darktown Strutters Ball. They played that down here then too, did they? I think that came from Chicago. It says, Piku, whose music aggregation was Tops at the turn of the century, has been actively engaged in music for almost 50 years. That's right. And Dixieland jazz was his first love and he continues to play it in his native city of New Orleans where he heads a seven-piece…
Where did you get the hat from, Pete?
